# dsh-movie · 影视雷达

A left-sidebar **screen radar** for DeepSeek Harness: one ranked board of
the movies and series that

are **in cinemas right now** or **open within the next month** across China, the
US, Europe, Japan

and Korea — with real posters, five-sentence synopses, popular short comments, a title
search that m
erges three sources, and a live Chinese/English switch that translates everything.

strip, and the title search at the right of the filter row.

## What you get
| **Ranked board** | A composite of buzz, Rotten Tomatoes, Douban and audience anticipation, with di

versity caps so one region or one media type cannot take over the list |
| **Posters, not placeholde
rs** | The board is a poster grid (2:3 cards with rank and score overlaid). Click a card for the ful
l record: large poster, whole synopsis, every comment. Posters are fetched by the Host and served fr
om the plugin's own origin, so a source CDN's hotlink rules cannot blank them; a title with no reach

able poster gets a designed plate that still reads as a card |
| **Title search** | The field at the
right of 「全部 · 上映中 · 待映」 narrows the board as you type, then queries Douban, TVMaze and the iTunes

storefront at once and merges their records for the same title into one row |
| **Five-sentence syno
psis** | The real one from Douban / TVMaze / iTunes when it can be fetched, otherwise a description

generated from the title's own metadata |
| **Ratings and comments** | Douban score, Tomatometer, IM

Db, buzz and anticipation chips, plus up to three popular short comments |
| **Bilingual titles** |

The title in your panel language leads, the original-language title follows as secondary text |
| **
One switch, two languages** | Every synopsis and comment is translated into the language you picked,
so the board never shows a Chinese comment inside an English panel |
## Sources
Every source is keyless — no API key, no account, nothing to configure.
| Source | Provides | Notes |
| Douban (`m.douban.com`) | Chinese title, synopsis, genres, score, popular short comments, release

date | Primary source for the China slate, and for the search |
| JustWatch | Poster, availability w
indow, Tomatometer, IMDb score, buzz | Primary source for the US / Europe / Japan / Korea slate; its

image CDN is unreachable on some networks, in which case the poster search below takes over |
| Dou
ban `subject_suggest` | Poster search by title | Used when a source cover is dead: the title's own D

ouban poster is fetched and proxied |
| iTunes charts | Chart position (buzz), pre-orders, English `

longDescription` | Storefronts per region; also the search's release dates and artwork |
| TVMaze |

Series air dates, English summary, rating | Series only; also the search's series data |
| Rotten To
matoes | Tomatometer via scrape | Best-effort; degrades to JustWatch's score when blocked |
Providers are independent: one unreachable source degrades the board and is reported in the panel's
source-health strip instead of failing the request.
## Search
Search runs on two levels, and it is the part people use most:
1. **Local, instantly** — typing the first character filters the current board by title, original ti

tle,
media type and genre. The 「全部 · 上映中 · 待映」 filters keep working alongside it.
2. **On the web, a

fter a 0.3 s pause** — the plugin asks Douban, TVMaze and iTunes in parallel and merges
their answer

s: one record per title, Douban supplying the Chinese name / synopsis / genres / score,
TVMaze the s
eries data, iTunes the release date and artwork. Results are cached for ten minutes.
Matches that already sit on the board are grouped under 「榜单内」 (click through to the detail view); th

e
rest appear under 「全网搜索」 with poster, bilingual title, year · type · genres, Douban score, a three

-line
synopsis, the sources that answered, and a link to the subject page.
Douban answers a burst of traffic with an empty body rather than an error, so the search retries tha

t one
source with backoff (0.45 s / 1.3 s / 2.6 s) before giving up. If it still fails you get the E

nglish-only
results instead of an error.
## Translation
The anonymous HTTP translators (`translate.googleapis.com`, Bing) are not reachable from every netwo

rk, so
the board goes through the Host `translator` service instead, which owns the keyless Bing/Goo

gle routes
together with their cancellation rules. One string per request, three in flight, a single

probe before
committing so a blocked route costs one timeout instead of one per string, and a fixed

time budget so a
slow route can never hold the board open. Every result is cached per language; a s

tring that cannot be

## Privacy

- No account, no API key, no telemetry, no analytics.
- What leaves the machine: the titles being lo

oked up (public sources), the text that needs translating
(through the Host translator service, i.e.

the same routes the rest of the harness uses), and image
requests for posters (through the plugin's

own proxy).
- Nothing is written outside the profile's `node_modules` and the plugin's in-memory ca

proxy).
